description: Système belge de localisation de la foudre (BELLS) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.be. Total lightning observations, i.e., cloud-to-ground (CG) strokes and intra/inter-cloud (IC) pulses, in Belgium. BELLS data is given in Universal Time! (local time winter = UT +1; local time summer = UT + 2). Each record contains following fields: 1. Network type, 0 = LF, 1 = VHF-TOA, 2 = VHF-ITF, 3 = VLF 2. Coverage: BE. The portal shows the English title as "Belgian Lightning Location System (BELLS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include observation, lightning, federal government. The listing shows 2025-10-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
